// PORTED (Batch C, 2026-11-05): old effect-player calls replaced by the PORT shim

// (_port-shim.js, header comment trimmed). Same look and timing as the legacy script.

// PORT.sound = AudioHelper broadcast; PORT.effect = webm via game.ONI.pseudo.play; PORT.wait.

// Pseudo inners hide tokens with oni.hideToken (guarded), never by toggling visibility.

const PORT = (() => {

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

function sound(src, volume) {

if (!src) return;

try {

const AH = (foundry && foundry.audio && foundry.audio.AudioHelper) || globalThis.AudioHelper;

AH.play({ src: src, volume: volume == null ? 0.8 : volume, autoplay: true, loop: false }, true);

} catch (e) { console.warn('[PORT] sound failed', src, e); }

}

const INNER = [

"const p = ctx.params || {};",

"const vid = document.createElement('video'); vid.src = p.file; vid.muted = true; vid.playsInline = true; vid.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';",

"let tex; try { tex = await loadTexture(p.file); } catch (e) { tex = null; }",

"if (!tex) return;",

"const v = tex.baseTexture && tex.baseTexture.resource && tex.baseTexture.resource.source;",

"const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex); spr.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);",

"const nw = (v && v.videoWidth) || tex.width || 100, nh = (v && v.videoHeight) || tex.height || 100;",

"const k = (p.scale || 1) * (canvas.grid.size / (p.fileGrid || 200));",

"spr.width = nw * k; spr.height = nh * k; if (p.mirrorX) spr.scale.x *= -1; if (p.mirrorY) spr.scale.y *= -1;",

"spr.angle = -(p.rotate || 0); spr.x = p.x; spr.y = p.y; spr.alpha = p.fadeIn ? 0 : (p.opacity == null ? 1 : p.opacity);",

"spr.zIndex = p.below ? 50 : 100500; canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true; canvas.stage.addChild(spr); canvas.stage.sortChildren();",

"const op = p.opacity == null ? 1 : p.opacity;",

"if (v) { try { v.loop = false; v.currentTime = 0; v.playbackRate = p.rate || 1; await v.play(); } catch (e) {} }",

"const dur = p.duration || ((v && isFinite(v.duration) ? v.duration * 1000 / (p.rate || 1) : 1000));",

"const t0 = performance.now();",

"await new Promise((res) => { const tick = () => { const e = performance.now() - t0; let a = op; if (p.fadeIn && e < p.fadeIn) a = op * e / p.fadeIn; if (p.fadeOut && e > dur - p.fadeOut) a = op * Math.max(0, (dur - e) / p.fadeOut); spr.alpha = a; if (e >= dur) { canvas.app.ticker.remove(tick); res(); } }; canvas.app.ticker.add(tick); });",

"try { spr.destroy(); } catch (e) {} try { if (v) v.pause(); } catch (e) {}",

].join("\n");

function fileGrid() { return 100; } // raw file path default: native px x scale x (scene grid / 100)

async function effect(o) {

let x = 0, y = 0;

const at = o.at && o.at.center ? o.at.center : (o.at || { x: 0, y: 0 });

x = at.x + ((o.offset && o.offset.x) || 0); y = at.y + ((o.offset && o.offset.y) || 0);

const params = { file: o.file, x, y, scale: o.scale, mirrorX: !!o.mirrorX, mirrorY: !!o.mirrorY, rotate: o.rotate || 0, fadeIn: o.fadeIn || 0, fadeOut: o.fadeOut || 0, below: !!o.below, opacity: o.opacity, duration: o.duration || 0, rate: o.rate || 1, fileGrid: o.fileGrid || fileGrid(o.file) };

try { await game.ONI.pseudo.play({ scriptId: 'port.effect', scriptSource: INNER, casterTokenUuid: null, targetTokenUuids: [], params }); } catch (e) { console.warn('[PORT] effect failed', o.file, e); }

}

return { sound, effect, wait };

})();

// ── Port helper (this script only) ──────────────────────────────────────────

// PORT.effect resolves as soon as the broadcast is sent; the old player's play()

// resolved when its effects finished. To keep the legacy end timing, read the

// clip length here on the GM (metadata only) and wait it out explicitly.

function __fxDurMs(file, fallback) {

return new Promise((res) => {

const v = document.createElement('video');

let done = false;

const fin = (d) => { if (done) return; done = true; try { v.removeAttribute('src'); v.load(); } catch (e) {} res(d); };

v.preload = 'metadata'; v.muted = true;

v.onloadedmetadata = () => fin(isFinite(v.duration) && v.duration > 0 ? v.duration * 1000 : fallback);

v.onerror = () => fin(fallback);

setTimeout(() => fin(fallback), 4000);

v.src = file;

});

}

}

// --- Payload ---

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

if (doc.object) return doc.object;

if (doc.document?.object) return doc.document.object;

}

if (Array.isArray(p.targets) && p.targets.length) {

const out = [];

for (const t of p.targets) {

else if (t?.tokenUuid) out.push(t.tokenUuid);

}

if (Array.isArray(p.rows)) {

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

const targetRefs = pickTargetsFromPayload(payload);

const fallbackSource = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const targets = [];

if (!targets.length) {

const targetToken = targets[0];

const casterDisposition =

const targetDisposition =

0;

const casterHostile = casterDisposition === -1;

const targetHostile = targetDisposition === -1;

// --- "Front of target" (JRPG side rule) ---

// Target hostile (-1) is on LEFT and faces RIGHT => front is RIGHT of target

// Target friendly (not -1) is on RIGHT and faces LEFT => front is LEFT of target

const frontIsRightOfTarget = targetHostile;

const squares = 0.60; // tweak

const offsetPx = canvas.grid.size * squares;

const destFront = {

};

const moveOutMs = 220;

const moveBackMs = 220;

// --- Conditional flip rule ---

// "friendly unit protect a hostile target" => caster friendly AND target hostile AND differ

const shouldFlipCaster =

(casterDisposition !== -1) && (targetDisposition === -1) && (casterDisposition !== targetDisposition);

// Mirror state of the REAL token (for reference / logging only)

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "skillProtect",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

meta: { casterHostile, targetHostile, frontIsRightOfTarget, shouldFlipCaster },

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// --- Assets ---

const FX_PROTECT =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Conditions/Boon01/ConditionBoon01_012_Green_600x600.webm";

const SFX_PROTECT = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Shield2.wav";

// Hold should cover: FX start + your scripted wait(2000) + moveBack time window.

// and the VFX is timed so it plays while the pseudo clone is in front.

const holdMs = 2000;

const scriptSource = `

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;

}

function animate(obj, fromX, fromY, toX, toY, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = fromX + (toX - fromX) * e;

obj.y = fromY + (toY - fromY) * e;

ticker.add(update);

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) { sprite.width = baseObj.width; sprite.height = baseObj.height; }

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

}

const toX = Number(params.toX);

const toY = Number(params.toY);

const moveOutMs = Number(params.moveOutMs ?? 220);

const holdMs = Number(params.holdMs ?? 0);

const moveBackMs = Number(params.moveBackMs ?? 220);

const shouldFlip = Boolean(params.shouldFlip ?? false);

let __restore = () => {};

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken); try { oni.depthFollow(sprite, casterToken); } catch (e) {}

// Hide real token locally (guarded hide; Foundry refresh cannot re-show it)

__restore = oni.hideToken(casterToken);

const homeX = sprite.x, homeY = sprite.y;

// Move OUT (X + Y)

await animate(sprite, homeX, homeY, toX, toY, moveOutMs);

// Flip AFTER arriving (only on pseudo clone)

if (shouldFlip) sprite.scale.x = -Math.abs(sprite.scale.x);

// Hold in front

if (holdMs > 0) await wait(holdMs);

// Flip back BEFORE returning (so return looks normal)

if (shouldFlip) sprite.scale.x = Math.abs(sprite.scale.x);

await animate(sprite, toX, toY, homeX, homeY, moveBackMs);

if (sprite) { canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite); sprite.destroy(); }

__restore();

}

// Convert destFront token-doc coords -> stage (center) coords for the sprite.

// Token center = document x/y + (w/2,h/2) grid pixels

const wPx = (sourceToken.document.width ?? 1) * canvas.grid.size;

const hPx = (sourceToken.document.height ?? 1) * canvas.grid.size;

const frontCenterX = destFront.x + wPx / 2;

const frontCenterY = destFront.y + hPx / 2;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.protect.moveToFrontHoldReturn",

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [targetToken.document.uuid],

params: {

toX: frontCenterX,

toY: frontCenterY,

moveOutMs,

holdMs,

moveBackMs,

shouldFlip: shouldFlipCaster,

},

meta: { source: "Protect", shouldFlipCaster, originalMirrorX },

});

// --- MAIN TIMELINE (VFX/SFX only) ---

const fxDurP = __fxDurMs(FX_PROTECT, 1000);

// Wait until pseudo arrival completes, then play FX/SFX (matches original "after arriving")

await PORT.wait(moveOutMs);

const fxStart = performance.now();

// FX on target + sound

PORT.sound(SFX_PROTECT, 0.95);

PORT.effect({

file: FX_PROTECT,

at: targetToken,

scale: 0.3, // ⬅ preserved from your code; change to 1.0 if you want header behavior

opacity: 1.0,

});

// Hold (same as your original)

await PORT.wait(holdMs);

// Wait the remainder of pseudo return time so animationEnd happens after everything is done

await PORT.wait(moveBackMs);

// The old player also waited for the FX clip itself to finish

const fxLeft = (await fxDurP) - (performance.now() - fxStart);

if (fxLeft > 0) await PORT.wait(fxLeft);

// --- Broadcast end ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "skillProtect",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END", { moveOutMs, holdMs, moveBackMs, shouldFlipCaster });

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} Animation crashed:`, err);

// Still emit animationEnd so pipeline won't hang

try {

globalThis.ONI?.emit?.(

"oni:animationEnd",

{ type: "skillProtect", error: true, timestamp: Date.now() },

{ local: true }

);

} catch (_) {}

}

})();

{};

(typeof context !== "undefined" && context) ? context : {

log: (...a) => console.log(TAG, ...a),

warn: (...a) => console.warn(TAG, ...a),

error: (...a) => console.error(TAG, ...a),

cancelPipeline: (reason = "Cancelled", opts = {}) => {

p.meta.__abortPipeline = true;

p.meta.__abortReason = String(reason);

p.meta.__abortNotify = !!opts?.notify;

return { cancelled: true, reason };

}

};

p.meta = p.meta || {};

const execMode = String(p?.meta?.executionMode ?? p?.executionMode ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();

// AutoPassive (turn_start refill) is fully declarative now — body is silent.

if (execMode === "autopassive") {

return ctx.cancelPipeline("Protect refill handled declaratively.", { notify: false });

}

// Reaction-mode redirect + gate + consume all run via the effect dispatcher

// before this body fires. If we're still here, the dispatcher must not have

// short-circuited — which means the reactor's sheet hit this directly. Bail.

if (execMode === "reaction") {

return ctx.cancelPipeline("Protect reaction handled declaratively.", { notify: false });

}

// MANUAL ACTION — direct invocation from the action bar / sheet. The effect

// dispatcher does not run for manual invocations, so we still self-gate

// against the Protect Charge AE here.

function uniq(arr = []) {

return [...new Set((Array.isArray(arr) ? arr : []).filter(Boolean).map(v => String(v).trim()).filter(Boolean))];

}

const reactorUuid =

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerUuid ?? p?.attackerActorUuid ?? null;

const chargesApi = globalThis?.FUCompanion?.api?.charges;

const reactorActor = reactorUuid

? await fromUuid(reactorUuid).then(d => d?.actor ?? d).catch(() => null)

: null;

const owned = chargesApi?.findOnActor?.(reactorActor, { key: "protect" }) ?? [];

if (!chargesApi || !owned.length) {

}

const protectEffect = owned[0].effect;

game.modules?.get("fabula-ultima-companion")?.api?.JRPGTargeting ??

globalThis.__ONI_JRPG_TARGETING_API__ ?? null;

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? };

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

g.ellipse(x0 + tx, y0 + ty, tx, ty, 0, Math.PI, 1.5 * Math.PI);

g.ellipse(x1 - tx, y0 + ty, tx, ty, 0, 1.5 * Math.PI, 2 * Math.PI);

l.y += (l.vy + Math.cos(l.age * l.sw * 2 + l.ph) * 12) * dt;

// ── The red cape (mockup .cape: 150 px disc, conic-gradient from 200deg) ──

let CAPE = null;

function capeArt() {

if (CAPE) return CAPE;

const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = 150; const g = c.getContext('2d');

let gr;

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)'); gr.addColorStop(0.2, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, '#b3122b');

gr.addColorStop(0.55, '#e0364d'); gr.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)');

function cape(at, ms, pt, pose) {

const art = capeArt();

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => {

const p = pose(E.sine(Math.min(1, e / ms))); if (p.a <= 0) return;

S.world.push({ z: 54, draw: (g) => { const s = 150 * U * p.sc; g.save(); g.translate(pt.x, pt.y); g.rotate(p.rot * RAD); g.globalAlpha = p.a; g.drawImage(art, -s / 2, -s / 2, s, s); g.restore(); } });

}

// ── The drawn rose (mockup roseUrl(): 64 x 96 canvas) ──

function roseArt() {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const q = E.ioQ(Math.min(1, e / ms)); const s = S.tok.c; s.dx += x0 + (x1 - x0) * q; s.dy += y0 + (y1 - y0) * q - Math.abs(Math.sin(q * Math.PI * steps)) * 12 * U; });

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

};

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

const toward = (k) => (Math.sign(cf.x - K.feet(tl, k).x) || 1);

const pxScale = (g) => { try { return Math.abs(g.getTransform().a) || 1; } catch (e) { return 1; } };

// ── mockup hurt(): brightness flash (220 ms) + a 300 ms horizontal shudder ──

function hurt(at, k) {

m.tint(at, 220, k, '#ffffff', (u) => 0.55 * (1 - u));

m.hold(at, at + 300, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; const u = Math.min(1, e / 300); q.dx += -Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 4) * 9 * U * (1 - u); });

}

// ── the mockup's drop-shadow(0 0 Npx colour) glow: a blurred silhouette under the token ──

function glow(k, t0, t1, color, blur) {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 4, draw: (g) => {

const q = S.tok[k], TT = TOK[k]; if (!q || !TT || q.hidden || q.alpha <= 0) return;

const c = tl.tinted(k, color); if (!c) return; const f = tl.feet(TT);

g.save(); g.translate(TT.x + q.dx, f.y + q.dy - (q.air || 0)); if (q.rot) g.rotate(q.rot); g.scale(TT.flip * q.sx, q.sy);

g.globalAlpha = q.alpha; g.filter = 'blur(' + (blur * 0.5 * U * pxScale(g)).toFixed(1) + 'px)';

for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) g.drawImage(c, -TT.w / 2, -TT.h * TT.foot, TT.w, TT.h);

g.restore();

} }));

}

// ── Rose petals: the mockup leafGust({ petals: true, burst }) physics, canvas-2D.

// A burst flings them out, drag bleeds the burst, they fall slowly (gravity vs air

// drag), sway on a pendulum, spin, flip in 3D (cos on x scale), land on the floor

// line, rest 1.4 s, fade 0.8 s. Simulated in mockup px around pt, drawn x U.

const PETAL_COL = ['#b3122b', '#d61f3c', '#8e0e22', '#e8435a', '#c4162f'];

let SEED = 31;

function petalShape(g, s, col) {

// the mockup's box: 1.2s x s, border-radius 60% 60% 50% 50% / 80% 80% 30% 30% (CSS-normalised)

const w = 1.2 * s, h = s, x0 = -w / 2, y0 = -h / 2, x1 = w / 2, y1 = h / 2;

const tx = 0.6 * s, ty = 0.667 * s, bx = 0.5 * s, by = 0.25 * s;

g.beginPath();

g.ellipse(x0 + tx, y0 + ty, tx, ty, 0, Math.PI, 1.5 * Math.PI);

g.ellipse(x1 - tx, y0 + ty, tx, ty, 0, 1.5 * Math.PI, 2 * Math.PI);

g.ellipse(x1 - bx, y1 - by, bx, by, 0, 0, 0.5 * Math.PI);

g.ellipse(x0 + bx, y1 - by, bx, by, 0, 0.5 * Math.PI, Math.PI);

g.closePath();

const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x0 + 0.4 * w, y0 + 0.3 * h, 0, x0 + 0.4 * w, y0 + 0.3 * h, Math.hypot(0.6 * w, 0.7 * h));

gr.addColorStop(0, '#ff8a9a'); gr.addColorStop(0.6, col); gr.addColorStop(1, col);

g.fillStyle = gr; g.fill();

}

function petals(at, pt, floorY, n, burst) {

const r = tl.rng(SEED += 17); const P = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {

const s = 8 + r() * 7;

P.push({ s, col: PETAL_COL[i % PETAL_COL.length], vx: (r() - 0.5) * 2 * burst, vy: -120 - r() * 200, x: (r() - 0.5) * 40, y: -30 + r() * 40,

rot: r() * 6, spin: (r() - 0.5) * 5, sw: 2 + r() * 2, ph: r() * 6, flip: 3 + r() * 4, floor: (floorY - pt.y) / U - r() * 30, age: -i * 0.05, fade: 1, landed: null });

}

const step = (dt) => {

for (const l of P) {

l.age += dt;

if (l.landed == null) {

l.vx += (-l.vx) * 1.6 * dt; // drag bleeds the burst

l.vy += (60 - l.vy * 1.8) * dt; // gravity vs air drag: slow terminal fall

l.x += (l.vx + Math.sin(l.age * l.sw + l.ph) * 38) * dt;

l.y += (l.vy + Math.cos(l.age * l.sw * 2 + l.ph) * 12) * dt;

l.rot += (l.spin + Math.sin(l.age * l.sw + l.ph) * 2) * dt;

if (l.y >= l.floor) { l.y = l.floor; l.landed = l.age; }

} else if (l.age - l.landed > 1.4) l.fade = Math.max(0, 1 - (l.age - l.landed - 1.4) / 0.8);

}

};

let last = 0;

m.hold(at, TOTAL, (e, S) => {

let d = Math.min(40, Math.max(0, e - last)); last = e; // the mockup clamps a frame to 40 ms

while (d > 0) { const h = Math.min(20, d); step(h / 1000); d -= h; }

const endA = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (TOTAL - at - e) / FADE));

S.world.push({ z: 55, draw: (g) => {

for (const l of P) {

const a = l.fade * endA; if (a <= 0.01) continue;

const fl = l.landed != null ? 0.35 : Math.cos(l.age * l.flip + l.ph);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + l.x * U, pt.y + l.y * U); g.rotate(l.rot); g.scale(fl, 1); g.globalAlpha = a;

petalShape(g, l.s * U, l.col); g.restore();

}

} });

});

}

// ── The red cape (mockup .cape: 150 px disc, conic-gradient from 200deg) ──

let CAPE = null;

function capeArt() {

if (CAPE) return CAPE;

const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = 150; const g = c.getContext('2d');

let gr;

if (g.createConicGradient) {

// CSS conic 'from 200deg' starts at 12 o'clock; canvas starts at 3 o'clock

gr = g.createConicGradient((200 - 90) * RAD, 75, 75);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)'); gr.addColorStop(0.2, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, '#b3122b');

gr.addColorStop(0.55, '#e0364d'); gr.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)');

} else { gr = g.createRadialGradient(75, 75, 0, 75, 75, 75); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)'); gr.addColorStop(0.7, '#b3122b'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)'); }

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(75, 75, 75, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();

return (CAPE = c);

}

// pose(q) with q = sine-eased progress -> { rot (deg), sc, a }

function cape(at, ms, pt, pose) {

const art = capeArt();

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => {

const p = pose(E.sine(Math.min(1, e / ms))); if (p.a <= 0) return;

S.world.push({ z: 54, draw: (g) => { const s = 150 * U * p.sc; g.save(); g.translate(pt.x, pt.y); g.rotate(p.rot * RAD); g.globalAlpha = p.a; g.drawImage(art, -s / 2, -s / 2, s, s); g.restore(); } });

});

}

// ── The drawn rose (mockup roseUrl(): 64 x 96 canvas) ──

function roseArt() {

const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 64; c.height = 96; const g = c.getContext('2d');

g.strokeStyle = '#2f6a2a'; g.lineWidth = 4; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(32, 40); g.quadraticCurveTo(36, 70, 30, 94); g.stroke();

g.fillStyle = '#3f8a35'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(42, 66, 9, 4, -0.6, 0, 6.3); g.fill(); g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(24, 76, 8, 3.5, 0.6, 0, 6.3); g.fill();

for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) { const a = i * 2.4, r = 20 - i * 1.9; g.fillStyle = i % 2 ? '#a3102a' : '#d61f3c'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(32 + Math.cos(a) * (9 - i), 28 + Math.sin(a) * (6 - i * 0.5), r, r * 0.75, a, 0, 6.3); g.fill(); }

g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,0,10,.5)'; g.lineWidth = 1.5; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { g.beginPath(); g.arc(32, 28, 4 + i * 4, i, i + 3.6); g.stroke(); }

return c;

}

// ── The anime anger mark (four inward-bulging red arcs), mockup angerMark(): 84 px,

// pops in (220 ms, scale 0 -> 1.25), throbs (500 ms), fades (220 ms). Fixed in place.

function angerMark(at, pt, size) {

const sz = size * U, mm = sz / 2;

const scaleAt = (e) => e < 220 ? 1.25 * E.outQ(e / 220) : e < 720 ? 1.1 + 0.15 * Math.abs(Math.sin((e - 220) / 500 * Math.PI * 3)) : 1.1 + 0.15 * Math.abs(Math.sin(Math.PI * 3));

const arcs = (g) => {

for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {

const sx = i % 2 ? 1 : -1, sy = i < 2 ? -1 : 1, R = sz * 0.44, r = sz * 0.33, cx = mm + sx * R, cy = mm + sy * R;

const a0 = Math.atan2(-sy, -sx) - Math.PI / 4 + 0.18, a1 = Math.atan2(-sy, -sx) + Math.PI / 4 - 0.18;

g.beginPath(); g.arc(cx, cy, r, a0, a1); g.stroke();

}

};

m.hold(at, at + 940, (e, S) => {

const s = scaleAt(e), a = e < 720 ? 1 : Math.max(0, 1 - (e - 720) / 220); if (a <= 0 || s <= 0) return;

S.world.push({ z: 58, draw: (g) => {

const px = pxScale(g);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x, pt.y); g.scale(s, s); g.translate(-mm, -mm); g.globalAlpha = a;

g.strokeStyle = '#e0242f'; g.lineWidth = sz * 0.11; g.lineCap = 'round';

g.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,.4)'; g.shadowOffsetY = 2 * U * px * s; g.shadowBlur = 2 * U * px * s; arcs(g);

g.shadowColor = '#ffffff'; g.shadowOffsetY = 0; g.shadowBlur = 3 * U * px * s; arcs(g);

g.restore();

} });

});

}

// mockup runTo(): ioQ ease, 12 px bob over 'steps' strides (the bob reads the EASED t, as the mockup does)

function runTo(at, ms, x0, y0, x1, y1, steps) {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const q = E.ioQ(Math.min(1, e / ms)); const s = S.tok.c; s.dx += x0 + (x1 - x0) * q; s.dy += y0 + (y1 - y0) * q - Math.abs(Math.sin(q * Math.PI * steps)) * 12 * U; });

}

// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if (kind === 'tafallera') {

// Run to stage centre, a 2.5-turn spin with 4 crimson cape-slash arcs and petals,

// a floor ring (perspective 0.45) that hits each enemy as it reaches them, run back.

const C = { x: tl.REST.cx, y: tl.REST.cy };

const DX = C.x - cf.x, DY = C.y - cf.y;

runTo(0, t.run, 0, 0, DX, DY, 5);

m.hold(t.run, t.back, (e, S) => { S.tok.c.dx += DX; S.tok.c.dy += DY; });

runTo(t.back, t.backMs, DX, DY, 0, 0, 5);

// the spin: scaleX = cos(5 pi q); it ends mirrored and snaps back when the ring is done (as in the mockup)

const ringEnd = t.ring + t.ringMs;

m.hold(t.run, ringEnd, (e, S) => { S.tok.c.sx *= e < t.spinMs ? Math.cos(E.sine(e / t.spinMs) * Math.PI * 5) : -1; });

const ctr = { x: C.x, y: C.y - CT.h * 0.45 };

for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {

const at = t.run + i * t.slashGap; const deg = i * 90 + 30;

// CSS 'scaleX(-1) rotate(r)' = canvas rotate(-r) then flip

m.clip('slash', at, { x: ctr.x, y: ctr.y, w: cw(512, 0.5), z: 50, add: true, filter: K.tintF(350, 6, 1.05), rot: (i % 2 ? -deg : deg) * RAD, flip: i % 2 === 1 });

petals(at, ctr, C.y + 40 * U, 6, 380);

}

// the ring: r 60 -> R mockup px (outQ, t.ringMs), ellipse 2r x 0.9r on the floor, fades to 10%

const dist = TG.map((k) => { const f = K.feet(tl, k); return Math.hypot(f.x - C.x, (f.y - C.y) / 0.45) / U; });

const R = Math.max(700, Math.max.apply(null, dist.concat([0])) + 40); // 700 as mocked; grown only if an enemy stands further out

TG.forEach((k, i) => {

const q = (dist[i] - 60) / (R - 60); const kk = q <= 0 ? 0 : 1 - Math.sqrt(1 - Math.min(1, q));

const at = Math.round(t.ring + t.ringMs * kk);

if (cfg.hitCue) SFX.push({ at, url: cfg.hitCue.url, v: cfg.hitCue.v });

const f = fp(k);

m.clip('sweep', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: cw(440, 1.2), z: 50 });

hurt(at, k);

});

m.hold(t.ring, ringEnd, (e, S) => {

const k = E.outQ(Math.min(1, e / t.ringMs)); const r = (60 + (R - 60) * k) * U;

S.world.push({ z: 3, draw: (g) => {

const px = pxScale(g);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = 1 - k * 0.9;

g.shadowColor = '#ff3355'; g.shadowBlur = 22 * U * px; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(225,40,70,.85)'; g.lineWidth = 10 * U;

g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(C.x, C.y, r, r * 0.45, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.stroke(); g.stroke();

g.restore();

} });

});

} else if (kind === 'capote') {

// Step out, a wide cape flourish with petals, the target snorts two puffs of steam, red power-down.

const tk = TG[0], tf = K.feet(tl, tk), TT = TOK[tk];

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.back, 60);

const hp = hand(dir * 60 * U);

cape(t.cape, t.capeMs, { x: hp.x + dir * 20 * U, y: hp.y }, (q) => ({ rot: -200 * q, sc: 0.6 + 0.6 * Math.sin(q * Math.PI), a: 1 - Math.max(0, q - 0.7) / 0.3 }));

petals(t.cape, hp, cf.y + 30 * U, 8, 220);

// the bull: two snorts from the muzzle (the side facing Blanche)

const nose = { x: tf.x + toward(tk) * TT.w * 0.32, y: tf.y - TT.h * 0.55 };

for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) m.clip('smoke', t.snort + i * 260, { x: nose.x, y: nose.y, w: cw(170, 1.1), z: 52, filter: 'brightness(1.4) grayscale(1)', alpha: () => 0.85 });

const f = fp(tk);

m.clip('pdown1', t.down, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: cw(508), z: 50, filter: 'hue-rotate(-250deg)' });

} else if (kind === 'castigo') {

// Step out, a drawn rose thrown spinning onto the target, petals burst, dark-red power-down.

const tk = TG[0], tf = K.feet(tl, tk);

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.back, 50);

const from = hand(dir * 50 * U), to = cp(tk); const rose = roseArt();

m.hold(t.toss, t.land, (e, S) => {

const k = Math.min(1, e / (t.land - t.toss));

const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * k, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * k - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * 170 * U;

S.world.push({ z: 56, draw: (g) => { const px = pxScale(g); g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.rotate(1080 * k * RAD);

g.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,.5)'; g.shadowOffsetY = 2 * U * px; g.shadowBlur = 3 * U * px; g.drawImage(rose, -32 * U, -48 * U, 64 * U, 96 * U); g.restore(); } });

});

petals(t.land, to, tf.y, 10, 200);

m.tint(t.land, 220, tk, '#ffffff', (u) => 0.3 * (1 - u)); // flashActor(wolf, 1.6)

const f = fp(tk);

m.clip('pdown2', t.land, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: cw(384, 1.2), z: 50, filter: 'hue-rotate(100deg)' });

} else if (kind === 'provoke') {

// Final toned-down Fury taunt: fury burst + red glow, smug bounces + lean back,

// anger mark on the target, then the target's tantrum (red glow, three hops with

// a squash on landing and a cartoon smoke puff + hiss each hop). No text.

const tk = TG[0], tf = K.feet(tl, tk), TT = TOK[tk];

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.back, 60);

const ff = fp('c', dir * 60 * U);

m.clip('pup2', t.fury, { x: ff.x, y: ff.y, w: cw(508, 0.9), z: 50, filter: 'hue-rotate(-55deg) saturate(1.6)' });

glow('c', t.fury, t.back, '#ff3030', 12);

m.tint(t.fury, t.back - t.fury, 'c', '#ffffff', () => 0.06); // brightness(1.1)

// two chin-up bounces (200 ms each, sine), then lean back 6 deg (220 ms) and hold

m.hold(t.fury, t.fury + 400, (e, S) => { const k = (e % 200) / 200; S.tok.c.air += 10 * U * Math.sin(E.sine(k) * Math.PI); });

m.hold(t.fury + 400, t.back, (e, S) => { S.tok.c.rot += -dir * 6 * RAD * E.outQ(Math.min(1, e / 220)); });

angerMark(t.mark, { x: tf.x + toward(tk) * 30 * U, y: hd(tk).y + 10 * U }, 84);

// the tantrum

m.tint(t.tantrum, t.back - t.tantrum, tk, '#ff2a1a', () => 0.35);

glow(tk, t.tantrum, t.back, '#ff2a2a', 10);

const top = hd(tk);

for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {

const h0 = t.tantrum + i * 400;

m.clip('smoke', h0, { x: top.x + (i % 2 ? 26 : -18) * U, y: top.y + 4 * U, w: cw(170, 1.2), z: 52, filter: 'grayscale(1) brightness(1.6)', alpha: () => 0.9 });

m.hold(h0, h0 + 170, (e, S) => { S.tok[tk].air += 34 * U * E.outQ(Math.min(1, e / 170)); });

m.hold(h0 + 170, h0 + 320, (e, S) => { S.tok[tk].air += 34 * U * (1 - E.inQ(Math.min(1, e / 150))); });

m.hold(h0 + 320, h0 + 400, (e, S) => { const s = Math.sin(E.outQ(Math.min(1, e / 80)) * Math.PI); S.tok[tk].sx *= 1 + 0.06 * s; S.tok[tk].sy *= 1 - 0.08 * s; });

}

} else if (kind === 'veronica') {

// Reaction when she is targeted: a slow cape pass across her body, petals trailing, a crest.

const c0 = cp('c');

petals(0, c0, cf.y + 20 * U, 10, 160);

cape(t.cape, t.capeMs, { x: cf.x, y: cf.y - CT.h * 0.45 }, (q) => ({ rot: 360 * q, sc: 1.2, a: 1 - Math.max(0, q - 0.7) / 0.3 }));

m.clip('pup3', t.crest, { x: c0.x, y: c0.y, w: cw(354, 0.9), z: 50 });

} else if (kind === 'invocation') {

// Wellspring pillar under her, an element orb arcs to the target, the element clip.

// The player picks the wellspring at resolve; the shot cannot see it, so cfg.el

// carries ONE default element (Fire).

const tk = TG[0]; const el = cfg.el || { hue: 12 };

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.back, 40);

const pf = fp('c', dir * 40 * U);

const pdur = Math.round(2467 / 1.4); // the mockup plays the pillar at rate 1.4

const pc = m.clip('pillar', t.pillar, { x: pf.x, y: pf.y, w: cw(384, 0.8), z: 50, add: true, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(el.hue - 45) + 'deg)', hold: pdur });

m.hold(t.pillar, t.pillar + pdur, () => { try { const v = pc && pc.copy && pc.copy.video; if (v && v.playbackRate !== 1.4) v.playbackRate = 1.4; } catch (e) {} });

const from = cp('c', dir * 40 * U), to = cp(tk); const col = 'hsl(' + el.hue + ',90%,60%)';

m.hold(t.orb, t.orb + t.orbMs, (e, S) => {

const k = Math.min(1, e / t.orbMs), q = E.ioQ(k);

const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(q * Math.PI) * 120 * U;

S.world.push({ z: 57, draw: (g) => { const r = 31 * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.18, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.4, col); gr.addColorStop(0.72, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); g.restore(); } });

});

const f = fp(tk);

m.clip('el', t.hit, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: cw(el.w || 776), z: 50 });

hurt(t.hit + (el.impact || 67), tk);

} else { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

await tl.run(T, { total: TOTAL, sfx: SFX, onStart: K.ready });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Capote" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

// ── PORT shim (party-ports/_port-shim.js): PORT.sound / PORT.effect / PORT.wait ──

// GM-side helpers; sound via Foundry AudioHelper (broadcast), effects via game.ONI.pseudo.play.

const PORT = (() => {

const wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

function sound(src, volume) {

if (!src) return;

try {

const AH = (foundry && foundry.audio && foundry.audio.AudioHelper) || globalThis.AudioHelper;

AH.play({ src: src, volume: volume == null ? 0.8 : volume, autoplay: true, loop: false }, true);

} catch (e) { console.warn('[PORT] sound failed', src, e); }

}

const INNER = [

"const p = ctx.params || {};",

"const vid = document.createElement('video'); vid.src = p.file; vid.muted = true; vid.playsInline = true; vid.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';",

"let tex; try { tex = await loadTexture(p.file); } catch (e) { tex = null; }",

"if (!tex) return;",

"const v = tex.baseTexture && tex.baseTexture.resource && tex.baseTexture.resource.source;",

"const spr = new PIXI.Sprite(tex); spr.anchor.set(0.5, 0.5);",

"const nw = (v && v.videoWidth) || tex.width || 100, nh = (v && v.videoHeight) || tex.height || 100;",

"const k = (p.scale || 1) * (canvas.grid.size / (p.fileGrid || 200));",

"spr.width = nw * k; spr.height = nh * k; if (p.mirrorX) spr.scale.x *= -1; if (p.mirrorY) spr.scale.y *= -1;",

"spr.angle = -(p.rotate || 0); spr.x = p.x; spr.y = p.y; spr.alpha = p.fadeIn ? 0 : (p.opacity == null ? 1 : p.opacity);",

"spr.zIndex = p.below ? 50 : 100500; canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true; canvas.stage.addChild(spr); canvas.stage.sortChildren();",

"const op = p.opacity == null ? 1 : p.opacity;",

"if (v) { try { v.loop = false; v.currentTime = 0; v.playbackRate = p.rate || 1; await v.play(); } catch (e) {} }",

"const dur = p.duration || ((v && isFinite(v.duration) ? v.duration * 1000 / (p.rate || 1) : 1000));",

"const t0 = performance.now();",

"await new Promise((res) => { const tick = () => { const e = performance.now() - t0; let a = op; if (p.fadeIn && e < p.fadeIn) a = op * e / p.fadeIn; if (p.fadeOut && e > dur - p.fadeOut) a = op * Math.max(0, (dur - e) / p.fadeOut); spr.alpha = a; if (e >= dur) { canvas.app.ticker.remove(tick); res(); } }; canvas.app.ticker.add(tick); });",

"try { spr.destroy(); } catch (e) {} try { if (v) v.pause(); } catch (e) {}",

].join("\n");

function fileGrid() { return 100; } // raw file path default: native px x scale x (scene grid / 100)

async function effect(o) {

let x = 0, y = 0;

const at = o.at && o.at.center ? o.at.center : (o.at || { x: 0, y: 0 });

x = at.x + ((o.offset && o.offset.x) || 0); y = at.y + ((o.offset && o.offset.y) || 0);

const params = { file: o.file, x, y, scale: o.scale, mirrorX: !!o.mirrorX, mirrorY: !!o.mirrorY, rotate: o.rotate || 0, fadeIn: o.fadeIn || 0, fadeOut: o.fadeOut || 0, below: !!o.below, opacity: o.opacity, duration: o.duration || 0, rate: o.rate || 1, fileGrid: o.fileGrid || fileGrid(o.file) };

try { await game.ONI.pseudo.play({ scriptId: 'port.effect', scriptSource: INNER, casterTokenUuid: null, targetTokenUuids: [], params }); } catch (e) { console.warn('[PORT] effect failed', o.file, e); }

}

return { sound, effect, wait };

})();

// ============================================================================

// Muleta - (Pipeline Version + "Run to Front" + Return) — PSEUDO MOVE

// UPDATE:

// - Token movement is now done via ONI Pseudo Animation (everything except VFX)

// - VFX/SFX via PORT shim (Piercing + Impact + Hit sound), broadcast to all clients

// - If CASTER disposition is NOT -1 (friendly), flip BOTH Piercing + Impact FX horizontally

// (mirrorX = true). If caster is hostile (-1), no flip.

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[Muleta]";

try {

if (!game.ONI?.pseudo?.play) {

ui.notifications.error("ONI Pseudo Animation API is not available (game.ONI.pseudo.play).");

return;

}

// Minimal ONI.emit helper

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

}

// --- Payload ---

const payload = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? {};

// --- Helpers ---

const isUuid = (v) => typeof v === "string" && v.includes(".");

async function resolveToken(ref) {

if (!ref) return null;

if (ref?.document && ref?.object) return ref;

if (ref?.id && canvas.tokens?.get(ref.id)) return canvas.tokens.get(ref.id);

if (isUuid(ref)) {

const doc = await fromUuid(ref);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.object) return doc.object;

if (doc.document?.object) return doc.document.object;

return null;

}

if (typeof ref === "string") return canvas.tokens.get(ref) ?? null;

return null;

}

function pickTargetsFromPayload(p) {

if (Array.isArray(p.targetTokenIds) && p.targetTokenIds.length) return p.targetTokenIds;

if (Array.isArray(p.targets) && p.targets.length) {

const out = [];

for (const t of p.targets) {

if (typeof t === "string") out.push(t);

else if (t?.tokenId) out.push(t.tokenId);

else if (t?.tokenUuid) out.push(t.tokenUuid);

}

return out.filter(Boolean);

}

if (Array.isArray(p.rows)) {

const out = [];

for (const r of p.rows) {

if (r?.targetTokenId) out.push(r.targetTokenId);

if (r?.targetTokenUuid) out.push(r.targetTokenUuid);

}

if (out.length) return out;

}

return [];

}

// --- Resolve caster & target ---

const sourceRef =

payload.sourceTokenUuid ??

payload.sourceTokenId ??

payload.casterTokenUuid ??

payload.casterTokenId ??

payload.attackerTokenUuid ??

payload.attackerTokenId ??

null;

const targetRefs = pickTargetsFromPayload(payload);

// Fallbacks for testing

const fallbackSource = canvas.tokens.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

const fallbackTargets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

const sourceToken = (await resolveToken(sourceRef)) ?? fallbackSource;

const targets = [];

for (const r of targetRefs) {

const tok = await resolveToken(r);

if (tok) targets.push(tok);

}

if (!targets.length && fallbackTargets.length) targets.push(...fallbackTargets);

if (!sourceToken) {

ui.notifications.warn("Muleta: No caster token (payload missing and nothing selected).");

return;

}

if (!targets.length) {

ui.notifications.warn("Muleta: No targets (payload missing and nothing targeted).");

return;

}

const targetToken = targets[0];

// --- Dispositions ---

const casterDisposition =

sourceToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

sourceToken?.document?.disposition ??

0;

const targetDisposition =

targetToken?.actor?.document?.disposition ??

targetToken?.document?.disposition ??

0;

const casterHostile = casterDisposition === -1;

const targetHostile = targetDisposition === -1;

// Flip rule you requested:

// If caster is NOT hostile (-1) => flip FX horizontally

const mirrorX = !casterHostile;

// --- Target disposition => decides where "front" is ---

const frontIsRightOfTarget = targetHostile;

// --- Movement (Pseudo: center-based) ---

const squares = 0.65;

const offsetPx = canvas.grid.size * squares;

const home = { x: sourceToken.center.x, y: sourceToken.center.y };

const front = {

x: targetToken.center.x + (frontIsRightOfTarget ? +offsetPx : -offsetPx),

y: targetToken.center.y,

};

const dx = front.x - home.x;

const dy = front.y - home.y;

const runMs = 280;

const walkBackMs = 480;

// Hold window (covers the Piercing VFX timeline before returning)

// If your Piercing file is longer/shorter, tune this number.

const HOLD_MS = 1000;

// --- Broadcast start ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationStart",

{

type: "skillMuleta",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

meta: { casterDisposition, targetDisposition, mirrorX, frontIsRightOfTarget },

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

// --- Assets ---

const FX_PIERCE =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Template/Line/Generic/Piercing_Generic01_01_Regular_Orange_1000x400.webm";

const FX_IMPACT =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Impact/Impact_09_Regular_Orange_400x400.webm";

const SFX_HIT =

"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/HitSlashS.ogg";

// --- PSEUDO MOVE (run to front -> hold -> return) ---

const pseudoScriptSource = `

const { casterToken, params } = ctx;

if (!casterToken) throw new Error("Muleta pseudo: missing casterToken");

function easeInOutCubic(t) {

return t < 0.5 ? 4*t*t*t : 1 - Math.pow(-2*t + 2, 3)/2;

}

function animateXY(obj, from, to, durMs) {

return new Promise(resolve => {

const start = performance.now();

const ticker = canvas.app.ticker;

const update = () => {

const raw = (performance.now() - start) / durMs;

const t = Math.min(Math.max(raw, 0), 1);

const e = easeInOutCubic(t);

obj.x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * e;

obj.y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * e;

if (t >= 1) { ticker.remove(update); resolve(); }

};

ticker.add(update);

});

}

async function createClone(token) {

const baseObj = token.mesh ?? token.icon;

const texture = baseObj?.texture ?? await loadTexture(token.document.texture.src);

const sprite = new PIXI.Sprite(texture);

sprite.anchor.set(0.5);

sprite.x = token.center.x;

sprite.y = token.center.y;

if (baseObj) { sprite.width = baseObj.width; sprite.height = baseObj.height; }

sprite.zIndex = 5000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true;

canvas.stage.addChild(sprite);

canvas.stage.sortChildren();

return sprite;

}

let __restore = null;

let sprite;

try {

sprite = await createClone(casterToken); try { oni.depthFollow(sprite, casterToken); } catch (e) {}

// hide real token locally

__restore = oni.hideToken(casterToken);

const start = { x: sprite.x, y: sprite.y };

const out = { x: start.x + Number(params.dx ?? 0), y: start.y + Number(params.dy ?? 0) };

const outMs = Number(params.outMs ?? 280);

const holdMs = Number(params.holdMs ?? 0);

const backMs = Number(params.backMs ?? 480);

// move out

await animateXY(sprite, start, out, outMs);

// hold while the VFX plays

await wait(holdMs);

// return

await animateXY(sprite, out, start, backMs);

} finally {

if (sprite) { canvas.stage.removeChild(sprite); sprite.destroy(); }

if (__restore) __restore();

}

`;

game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "oni.muleta.runToFrontReturn",

scriptSource: pseudoScriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [targetToken.document.uuid],

params: {

dx,

dy,

outMs: runMs,

holdMs: HOLD_MS,

backMs: walkBackMs,

},

meta: { source: "Muleta" },

});

// --- MAIN VFX/SFX (PORT shim) ---

// Start after the caster reaches the front.

const delayToHit = runMs + 30;

// scaleToObject(S) on a token = effect width fitted to token width x S (aspect kept).

// PORT.effect scales native px x scale x (grid / fileGrid); with fileGrid = grid the

// grid factor cancels, so scale = tokenWidth x S / native file width (from file name).

const tW = targetToken.w ?? ((targetToken.document?.width ?? 1) * canvas.grid.size);

await PORT.wait(delayToHit);

// 1) SFX + FX (Pierce + Impact together), wait for the pierce FX to finish

PORT.sound(SFX_HIT, 0.95);

// Impact (quick, layered) - not waited, as in the legacy

PORT.effect({ file: FX_IMPACT, at: targetToken, scale: (tW * 1.35) / 400, fileGrid: canvas.grid.size, mirrorX, opacity: 1.0 });

// Pierce (main line) - waitUntilFinished

await PORT.effect({ file: FX_PIERCE, at: targetToken, scale: (tW * 3.5) / 1000, fileGrid: canvas.grid.size, mirrorX, opacity: 1.0 });

// --- Broadcast end ---

ONI.emit(

"oni:animationEnd",

{

type: "skillMuleta",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: [targetToken.id],

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now(),

},

{ local: true, world: false }

);

console.log(TAG, "END");

} catch (err) {

console.error(`${TAG} Animation crashed:`, err);

// Still emit animationEnd so pipeline won't hang

try {

globalThis.ONI?.emit?.(

"oni:animationEnd",

{ type: "skillMuleta", error: true, timestamp: Date.now() },

{ local: true }

);

} catch (_) {}

}

})();

// ============================================================================

return (async () => {

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Descabello]";

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// TUNING KNOBS

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const PRE_RUSH_DELAY_MS = 2500;

const Z_BLACKOUT = 7000;

const Z_AFTERIMAGE = 7999;

const Z_TARGET_FEEDBACK = 8100;

const Z_IMPACT = 8200;

const Z_DOM_FLASH = 2147483000;

const IMPACT_AT_MS = PRE_RUSH_DELAY_MS + FLASH_IN_MS + FLASH_OUT_MS + RUSH_MS;

const TOTAL_MS =

IMPACT_AT_MS +

HOLD_AFTER_IMPACT_MS +

BLACKOUT_FADE_OUT_MS +

RETURN_JUMP_MS +

350;

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function toTokenPlaceable(x) {

if (!x) return null;

if (x?.document?.documentName === "Token") return x;

if (x?.documentName === "Token") return x.object ?? null;

if (x?.object?.document?.documentName === "Token") return x.object;

return null;

}

async function tokenFromUuidish(uuidish) {

if (!uuidish || typeof uuidish !== "string") return null;

try {

const doc = await fromUuid(uuidish);

if (!doc) return null;

if (doc.documentName === "Token") return doc.object ?? null;

if (doc.documentName === "Actor") {

return doc.getActiveTokens?.(true, true)?.[0] ?? null;

}

if (doc.actor?.getActiveTokens) {

return doc.actor.getActiveTokens(true, true)?.[0] ?? null;

}

props.custom_logic_action:
// ============================================================================

// Descabello - Custom Logic Action

// Adds:

// 1) Half caster level as bonus damage, rounded up.

// 2) Skill Enhancement bonus based on caster level:

// Lv. 20+ = base damage becomes 40, so add +10.

// Lv. 40+ = base damage becomes 50, so add +20.

//

// IMPORTANT:

// Keep the skill's normal Damage Bonus field at 30 on the sheet.

// This script adds the enhancement difference as bonus damage.

// ============================================================================

(async () => {

const TAG = "[CL-ACTION][DESCABELLO]";

const p = __PAYLOAD;

if (!p) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing __PAYLOAD.");

return;

}

p.advPayload = p.advPayload || {};

p.meta = p.meta || {};

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// 1) Resolve caster / attacker

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

const attackerUuid =

p?.meta?.attackerUuid ??

p?.attackerActorUuid ??

p?.attackerUuid ??

"";

if (!attackerUuid) {

console.warn(TAG, "Missing attacker UUID.", { payload: p });

return;

}

const attackerDoc = await fromUuid(attackerUuid);

const attackerActor = attackerDoc?.actor ?? attackerDoc;

if (!attackerActor) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve attacker actor.", { attackerUuid });

return;

}

const props = attackerActor.system?.props ?? {};

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// 2) Read caster level

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// Tries several possible level keys, so this is safer if your sheet name changes.

const levelCandidates = [

props.level,

props.current_level,

props.character_level,

props.lv,

props.Level

];

let casterLevel = 0;

for (const raw of levelCandidates) {

const n = Number(raw);

if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) {

casterLevel = n;

break;

}

}

if (!casterLevel) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not detect caster level. No bonus applied.", {

actor: attackerActor.name,

checkedKeys: ["level", "current_level", "character_level", "lv", "Level"]

});

return;

}

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// 3) Calculate bonus damage

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

const halfLevelBonus = Math.ceil(casterLevel / 2);

let enhancementBonus = 0;

let enhancementTier = "None";

if (casterLevel >= 40) {

enhancementBonus = 20; // 30 -> 50

enhancementTier = "Lv. 40 Enhancement";

} else if (casterLevel >= 20) {

enhancementBonus = 10; // 30 -> 40

enhancementTier = "Lv. 20 Enhancement";

}

const totalBonus = halfLevelBonus + enhancementBonus;

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

// 4) Apply to advPayload.bonus

// --------------------------------------------------------------------------

const beforeBonus = Number(p.advPayload.bonus ?? 0) || 0;

p.advPayload.bonus = beforeBonus + totalBonus;

// Optional debug info saved into payload meta.

p.meta.descabello = {

casterLevel,

halfLevelBonus,

enhancementTier,

enhancementBonus,

totalBonus,

bonusBefore: beforeBonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

};

console.log(TAG, "Applied Descabello bonus damage.", {

caster: attackerActor.name,

casterLevel,

halfLevelBonus,

enhancementTier,

enhancementBonus,

totalBonus,

bonusBefore: beforeBonus,

bonusAfter: p.advPayload.bonus

});

})();

// mockup anchors (OY = feet): feet() = OY - 8, center() = OY - H/2, head() = OY - 0.95 H

const fp = (k, ox) => { const f = K.feet(tl, k); return { x: f.x + (ox || 0), y: f.y - 8 * U }; };

const cp = (k, ox) => { const f = K.feet(tl, k); return { x: f.x + (ox || 0), y: f.y - TOK[k].h * 0.5 }; };

const hd = (k) => { const f = K.feet(tl, k); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - TOK[k].h * 0.95 }; };

// mockup hand(): 34 px ahead of her, at 45% height; ox = how far she has stepped

const hand = (ox) => ({ x: cf.x + ox + dir * 34 * U, y: cf.y - CT.h * 0.45 });

// the side of an enemy that faces Blanche (mockup enemies face right, toward the party)

const toward = (k) => (Math.sign(cf.x - K.feet(tl, k).x) || 1);

const pxScale = (g) => { try { return Math.abs(g.getTransform().a) || 1; } catch (e) { return 1; } };

// ── mockup hurt(): brightness flash (220 ms) + a 300 ms horizontal shudder ──

function hurt(at, k) {

m.tint(at, 220, k, '#ffffff', (u) => 0.55 * (1 - u));

m.hold(at, at + 300, (e, S) => { const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return; const u = Math.min(1, e / 300); q.dx += -Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 4) * 9 * U * (1 - u); });

}

// ── the mockup's drop-shadow(0 0 Npx colour) glow: a blurred silhouette under the token ──

function glow(k, t0, t1, color, blur) {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 4, draw: (g) => {

const q = S.tok[k], TT = TOK[k]; if (!q || !TT || q.hidden || q.alpha <= 0) return;

const c = tl.tinted(k, color); if (!c) return; const f = tl.feet(TT);

g.save(); g.translate(TT.x + q.dx, f.y + q.dy - (q.air || 0)); if (q.rot) g.rotate(q.rot); g.scale(TT.flip * q.sx, q.sy);

g.globalAlpha = q.alpha; g.filter = 'blur(' + (blur * 0.5 * U * pxScale(g)).toFixed(1) + 'px)';

for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) g.drawImage(c, -TT.w / 2, -TT.h * TT.foot, TT.w, TT.h);

g.restore();

} }));

}

// ── Rose petals: the mockup leafGust({ petals: true, burst }) physics, canvas-2D.

// A burst flings them out, drag bleeds the burst, they fall slowly (gravity vs air

// drag), sway on a pendulum, spin, flip in 3D (cos on x scale), land on the floor

// line, rest 1.4 s, fade 0.8 s. Simulated in mockup px around pt, drawn x U.

const PETAL_COL = ['#b3122b', '#d61f3c', '#8e0e22', '#e8435a', '#c4162f'];

let SEED = 31;

function petalShape(g, s, col) {

// the mockup's box: 1.2s x s, border-radius 60% 60% 50% 50% / 80% 80% 30% 30% (CSS-normalised)

const w = 1.2 * s, h = s, x0 = -w / 2, y0 = -h / 2, x1 = w / 2, y1 = h / 2;

const tx = 0.6 * s, ty = 0.667 * s, bx = 0.5 * s, by = 0.25 * s;

g.beginPath();

g.ellipse(x0 + tx, y0 + ty, tx, ty, 0, Math.PI, 1.5 * Math.PI);

g.ellipse(x1 - tx, y0 + ty, tx, ty, 0, 1.5 * Math.PI, 2 * Math.PI);

g.ellipse(x1 - bx, y1 - by, bx, by, 0, 0, 0.5 * Math.PI);

g.ellipse(x0 + bx, y1 - by, bx, by, 0, 0.5 * Math.PI, Math.PI);

g.closePath();

const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x0 + 0.4 * w, y0 + 0.3 * h, 0, x0 + 0.4 * w, y0 + 0.3 * h, Math.hypot(0.6 * w, 0.7 * h));

gr.addColorStop(0, '#ff8a9a'); gr.addColorStop(0.6, col); gr.addColorStop(1, col);

g.fillStyle = gr; g.fill();

}

function petals(at, pt, floorY, n, burst) {

const r = tl.rng(SEED += 17); const P = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {

const s = 8 + r() * 7;

P.push({ s, col: PETAL_COL[i % PETAL_COL.length], vx: (r() - 0.5) * 2 * burst, vy: -120 - r() * 200, x: (r() - 0.5) * 40, y: -30 + r() * 40,

rot: r() * 6, spin: (r() - 0.5) * 5, sw: 2 + r() * 2, ph: r() * 6, flip: 3 + r() * 4, floor: (floorY - pt.y) / U - r() * 30, age: -i * 0.05, fade: 1, landed: null });

}

const step = (dt) => {

for (const l of P) {

l.age += dt;

if (l.landed == null) {

l.vx += (-l.vx) * 1.6 * dt; // drag bleeds the burst

l.vy += (60 - l.vy * 1.8) * dt; // gravity vs air drag: slow terminal fall

l.x += (l.vx + Math.sin(l.age * l.sw + l.ph) * 38) * dt;

l.y += (l.vy + Math.cos(l.age * l.sw * 2 + l.ph) * 12) * dt;

l.rot += (l.spin + Math.sin(l.age * l.sw + l.ph) * 2) * dt;

if (l.y >= l.floor) { l.y = l.floor; l.landed = l.age; }

} else if (l.age - l.landed > 1.4) l.fade = Math.max(0, 1 - (l.age - l.landed - 1.4) / 0.8);

}

};

let last = 0;

m.hold(at, TOTAL, (e, S) => {

let d = Math.min(40, Math.max(0, e - last)); last = e; // the mockup clamps a frame to 40 ms

while (d > 0) { const h = Math.min(20, d); step(h / 1000); d -= h; }

const endA = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (TOTAL - at - e) / FADE));

S.world.push({ z: 55, draw: (g) => {

for (const l of P) {

const a = l.fade * endA; if (a <= 0.01) continue;

const fl = l.landed != null ? 0.35 : Math.cos(l.age * l.flip + l.ph);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + l.x * U, pt.y + l.y * U); g.rotate(l.rot); g.scale(fl, 1); g.globalAlpha = a;

petalShape(g, l.s * U, l.col); g.restore();

}

} });

});

}

// ── The red cape (mockup .cape: 150 px disc, conic-gradient from 200deg) ──

let CAPE = null;

function capeArt() {

if (CAPE) return CAPE;

const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = 150; const g = c.getContext('2d');

let gr;

if (g.createConicGradient) {

// CSS conic 'from 200deg' starts at 12 o'clock; canvas starts at 3 o'clock

gr = g.createConicGradient((200 - 90) * RAD, 75, 75);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)'); gr.addColorStop(0.2, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, '#b3122b');

gr.addColorStop(0.55, '#e0364d'); gr.addColorStop(0.75, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)');

} else { gr = g.createRadialGradient(75, 75, 0, 75, 75, 75); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)'); gr.addColorStop(0.7, '#b3122b'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(190,20,40,0)'); }

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(75, 75, 75, 0, 6.2832); g.fill();

return (CAPE = c);

}

// pose(q) with q = sine-eased progress -> { rot (deg), sc, a }

function cape(at, ms, pt, pose) {

const art = capeArt();

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => {

const p = pose(E.sine(Math.min(1, e / ms))); if (p.a <= 0) return;

S.world.push({ z: 54, draw: (g) => { const s = 150 * U * p.sc; g.save(); g.translate(pt.x, pt.y); g.rotate(p.rot * RAD); g.globalAlpha = p.a; g.drawImage(art, -s / 2, -s / 2, s, s); g.restore(); } });

});

}

// ── The drawn rose (mockup roseUrl(): 64 x 96 canvas) ──

function roseArt() {

const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 64; c.height = 96; const g = c.getContext('2d');

g.strokeStyle = '#2f6a2a'; g.lineWidth = 4; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(32, 40); g.quadraticCurveTo(36, 70, 30, 94); g.stroke();

g.fillStyle = '#3f8a35'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(42, 66, 9, 4, -0.6, 0, 6.3); g.fill(); g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(24, 76, 8, 3.5, 0.6, 0, 6.3); g.fill();

for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) { const a = i * 2.4, r = 20 - i * 1.9; g.fillStyle = i % 2 ? '#a3102a' : '#d61f3c'; g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(32 + Math.cos(a) * (9 - i), 28 + Math.sin(a) * (6 - i * 0.5), r, r * 0.75, a, 0, 6.3); g.fill(); }

g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,0,10,.5)'; g.lineWidth = 1.5; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { g.beginPath(); g.arc(32, 28, 4 + i * 4, i, i + 3.6); g.stroke(); }

return c;

}

// ── The anime anger mark (four inward-bulging red arcs), mockup angerMark(): 84 px,

// pops in (220 ms, scale 0 -> 1.25), throbs (500 ms), fades (220 ms). Fixed in place.

function angerMark(at, pt, size) {

const sz = size * U, mm = sz / 2;

const scaleAt = (e) => e < 220 ? 1.25 * E.outQ(e / 220) : e < 720 ? 1.1 + 0.15 * Math.abs(Math.sin((e - 220) / 500 * Math.PI * 3)) : 1.1 + 0.15 * Math.abs(Math.sin(Math.PI * 3));

const arcs = (g) => {

for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {

const sx = i % 2 ? 1 : -1, sy = i < 2 ? -1 : 1, R = sz * 0.44, r = sz * 0.33, cx = mm + sx * R, cy = mm + sy * R;

const a0 = Math.atan2(-sy, -sx) - Math.PI / 4 + 0.18, a1 = Math.atan2(-sy, -sx) + Math.PI / 4 - 0.18;

g.beginPath(); g.arc(cx, cy, r, a0, a1); g.stroke();

}

};

m.hold(at, at + 940, (e, S) => {

const s = scaleAt(e), a = e < 720 ? 1 : Math.max(0, 1 - (e - 720) / 220); if (a <= 0 || s <= 0) return;

S.world.push({ z: 58, draw: (g) => {

const px = pxScale(g);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x, pt.y); g.scale(s, s); g.translate(-mm, -mm); g.globalAlpha = a;

g.strokeStyle = '#e0242f'; g.lineWidth = sz * 0.11; g.lineCap = 'round';

g.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,.4)'; g.shadowOffsetY = 2 * U * px * s; g.shadowBlur = 2 * U * px * s; arcs(g);

g.shadowColor = '#ffffff'; g.shadowOffsetY = 0; g.shadowBlur = 3 * U * px * s; arcs(g);

g.restore();

} });

});

}

// mockup runTo(): ioQ ease, 12 px bob over 'steps' strides (the bob reads the EASED t, as the mockup does)

function runTo(at, ms, x0, y0, x1, y1, steps) {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const q = E.ioQ(Math.min(1, e / ms)); const s = S.tok.c; s.dx += x0 + (x1 - x0) * q; s.dy += y0 + (y1 - y0) * q - Math.abs(Math.sin(q * Math.PI * steps)) * 12 * U; });

}

// ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

if (kind === 'tafallera') {

// Run to stage centre, a 2.5-turn spin with 4 crimson cape-slash arcs and petals,

// a floor ring (perspective 0.45) that hits each enemy as it reaches them, run back.

const C = { x: tl.REST.cx, y: tl.REST.cy };

const DX = C.x - cf.x, DY = C.y - cf.y;

runTo(0, t.run, 0, 0, DX, DY, 5);

m.hold(t.run, t.back, (e, S) => { S.tok.c.dx += DX; S.tok.c.dy += DY; });

runTo(t.back, t.backMs, DX, DY, 0, 0, 5);

// the spin: scaleX = cos(5 pi q); it ends mirrored and snaps back when the ring is done (as in the mockup)

const ringEnd = t.ring + t.ringMs;

m.hold(t.run, ringEnd, (e, S) => { S.tok.c.sx *= e < t.spinMs ? Math.cos(E.sine(e / t.spinMs) * Math.PI * 5) : -1; });

const ctr = { x: C.x, y: C.y - CT.h * 0.45 };

for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {

const at = t.run + i * t.slashGap; const deg = i * 90 + 30;

// CSS 'scaleX(-1) rotate(r)' = canvas rotate(-r) then flip

m.clip('slash', at, { x: ctr.x, y: ctr.y, w: cw(512, 0.5), z: 50, add: true, filter: K.tintF(350, 6, 1.05), rot: (i % 2 ? -deg : deg) * RAD, flip: i % 2 === 1 });

petals(at, ctr, C.y + 40 * U, 6, 380);

}

// the ring: r 60 -> R mockup px (outQ, t.ringMs), ellipse 2r x 0.9r on the floor, fades to 10%

const dist = TG.map((k) => { const f = K.feet(tl, k); return Math.hypot(f.x - C.x, (f.y - C.y) / 0.45) / U; });

const R = Math.max(700, Math.max.apply(null, dist.concat([0])) + 40); // 700 as mocked; grown only if an enemy stands further out

TG.forEach((k, i) => {

const q = (dist[i] - 60) / (R - 60); const kk = q <= 0 ? 0 : 1 - Math.sqrt(1 - Math.min(1, q));

const at = Math.round(t.ring + t.ringMs * kk);

if (cfg.hitCue) SFX.push({ at, url: cfg.hitCue.url, v: cfg.hitCue.v });

const f = fp(k);

m.clip('sweep', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: cw(440, 1.2), z: 50 });

hurt(at, k);

});

m.hold(t.ring, ringEnd, (e, S) => {

const k = E.outQ(Math.min(1, e / t.ringMs)); const r = (60 + (R - 60) * k) * U;

S.world.push({ z: 3, draw: (g) => {

const px = pxScale(g);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = 1 - k * 0.9;

g.shadowColor = '#ff3355'; g.shadowBlur = 22 * U * px; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(225,40,70,.85)'; g.lineWidth = 10 * U;

g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(C.x, C.y, r, r * 0.45, 0, 0, 6.2832); g.stroke(); g.stroke();

g.restore();

} });

});

} else if (kind === 'capote') {

// Step out, a wide cape flourish with petals, the target snorts two puffs of steam, red power-down.

const tk = TG[0], tf = K.feet(tl, tk), TT = TOK[tk];

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.back, 60);

const hp = hand(dir * 60 * U);

cape(t.cape, t.capeMs, { x: hp.x + dir * 20 * U, y: hp.y }, (q) => ({ rot: -200 * q, sc: 0.6 + 0.6 * Math.sin(q * Math.PI), a: 1 - Math.max(0, q - 0.7) / 0.3 }));

petals(t.cape, hp, cf.y + 30 * U, 8, 220);

// the bull: two snorts from the muzzle (the side facing Blanche)

const nose = { x: tf.x + toward(tk) * TT.w * 0.32, y: tf.y - TT.h * 0.55 };

for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) m.clip('smoke', t.snort + i * 260, { x: nose.x, y: nose.y, w: cw(170, 1.1), z: 52, filter: 'brightness(1.4) grayscale(1)', alpha: () => 0.85 });

const f = fp(tk);

m.clip('pdown1', t.down, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: cw(508), z: 50, filter: 'hue-rotate(-250deg)' });

} else if (kind === 'castigo') {

// Step out, a drawn rose thrown spinning onto the target, petals burst, dark-red power-down.

const tk = TG[0], tf = K.feet(tl, tk);

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.back, 50);

const from = hand(dir * 50 * U), to = cp(tk); const rose = roseArt();

m.hold(t.toss, t.land, (e, S) => {

const k = Math.min(1, e / (t.land - t.toss));

const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * k, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * k - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * 170 * U;

S.world.push({ z: 56, draw: (g) => { const px = pxScale(g); g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.rotate(1080 * k * RAD);

g.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,.5)'; g.shadowOffsetY = 2 * U * px; g.shadowBlur = 3 * U * px; g.drawImage(rose, -32 * U, -48 * U, 64 * U, 96 * U); g.restore(); } });

});

petals(t.land, to, tf.y, 10, 200);

m.tint(t.land, 220, tk, '#ffffff', (u) => 0.3 * (1 - u)); // flashActor(wolf, 1.6)

const f = fp(tk);

m.clip('pdown2', t.land, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: cw(384, 1.2), z: 50, filter: 'hue-rotate(100deg)' });

} else if (kind === 'provoke') {

// Final toned-down Fury taunt: fury burst + red glow, smug bounces + lean back,

// anger mark on the target, then the target's tantrum (red glow, three hops with

// a squash on landing and a cartoon smoke puff + hiss each hop). No text.

const tk = TG[0], tf = K.feet(tl, tk), TT = TOK[tk];

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.back, 60);

const ff = fp('c', dir * 60 * U);

m.clip('pup2', t.fury, { x: ff.x, y: ff.y, w: cw(508, 0.9), z: 50, filter: 'hue-rotate(-55deg) saturate(1.6)' });

glow('c', t.fury, t.back, '#ff3030', 12);

m.tint(t.fury, t.back - t.fury, 'c', '#ffffff', () => 0.06); // brightness(1.1)

// two chin-up bounces (200 ms each, sine), then lean back 6 deg (220 ms) and hold

m.hold(t.fury, t.fury + 400, (e, S) => { const k = (e % 200) / 200; S.tok.c.air += 10 * U * Math.sin(E.sine(k) * Math.PI); });

m.hold(t.fury + 400, t.back, (e, S) => { S.tok.c.rot += -dir * 6 * RAD * E.outQ(Math.min(1, e / 220)); });

angerMark(t.mark, { x: tf.x + toward(tk) * 30 * U, y: hd(tk).y + 10 * U }, 84);

// the tantrum

m.tint(t.tantrum, t.back - t.tantrum, tk, '#ff2a1a', () => 0.35);

glow(tk, t.tantrum, t.back, '#ff2a2a', 10);

const top = hd(tk);

for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {

const h0 = t.tantrum + i * 400;

m.clip('smoke', h0, { x: top.x + (i % 2 ? 26 : -18) * U, y: top.y + 4 * U, w: cw(170, 1.2), z: 52, filter: 'grayscale(1) brightness(1.6)', alpha: () => 0.9 });

m.hold(h0, h0 + 170, (e, S) => { S.tok[tk].air += 34 * U * E.outQ(Math.min(1, e / 170)); });

m.hold(h0 + 170, h0 + 320, (e, S) => { S.tok[tk].air += 34 * U * (1 - E.inQ(Math.min(1, e / 150))); });

m.hold(h0 + 320, h0 + 400, (e, S) => { const s = Math.sin(E.outQ(Math.min(1, e / 80)) * Math.PI); S.tok[tk].sx *= 1 + 0.06 * s; S.tok[tk].sy *= 1 - 0.08 * s; });

}

} else if (kind === 'veronica') {

// Reaction when she is targeted: a slow cape pass across her body, petals trailing, a crest.

const c0 = cp('c');

petals(0, c0, cf.y + 20 * U, 10, 160);

cape(t.cape, t.capeMs, { x: cf.x, y: cf.y - CT.h * 0.45 }, (q) => ({ rot: 360 * q, sc: 1.2, a: 1 - Math.max(0, q - 0.7) / 0.3 }));

m.clip('pup3', t.crest, { x: c0.x, y: c0.y, w: cw(354, 0.9), z: 50 });

} else if (kind === 'invocation') {

// Wellspring pillar under her, an element orb arcs to the target, the element clip.

// The player picks the wellspring at resolve; the shot cannot see it, so cfg.el

// carries ONE default element (Fire).

const tk = TG[0]; const el = cfg.el || { hue: 12 };

K.step(m, E, U, dir, 'c', 0, 0, t.back, 40);

const pf = fp('c', dir * 40 * U);

const pdur = Math.round(2467 / 1.4); // the mockup plays the pillar at rate 1.4

const pc = m.clip('pillar', t.pillar, { x: pf.x, y: pf.y, w: cw(384, 0.8), z: 50, add: true, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(el.hue - 45) + 'deg)', hold: pdur });

m.hold(t.pillar, t.pillar + pdur, () => { try { const v = pc && pc.copy && pc.copy.video; if (v && v.playbackRate !== 1.4) v.playbackRate = 1.4; } catch (e) {} });

const from = cp('c', dir * 40 * U), to = cp(tk); const col = 'hsl(' + el.hue + ',90%,60%)';

m.hold(t.orb, t.orb + t.orbMs, (e, S) => {

const k = Math.min(1, e / t.orbMs), q = E.ioQ(k);

const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(q * Math.PI) * 120 * U;

S.world.push({ z: 57, draw: (g) => { const r = 31 * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.18, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.4, col); gr.addColorStop(0.72, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)');

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.2832); g.fill(); g.restore(); } });

});

const f = fp(tk);

m.clip('el', t.hit, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: cw(el.w || 776), z: 50 });

hurt(t.hit + (el.impact || 67), tk);

} else { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

await tl.run(T, { total: TOTAL, sfx: SFX, onStart: K.ready });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Provoke" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();
props.description:
You may use an action and spend 5 Mind Points to perform an Opposed 【MIG + WLP】 Check against a creature you can see — describe how you taunt them! If you succeed, the target suffers Enraged andProvoked. This compulsion ends if you fall unconscious or leave the scene, if the creature is no longer enraged, or if they are successfully provoked by someone else.

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.party.blanche-castigo";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Castigo]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {
